info.title: QuickFlow API
info.description: Single-user productivity API: tasks, habits, learning resources, plans, dashboard. Errors are RFC 7807 problem+json; validation errors list {field, message} in `errors`.

404.description: Card, milestone or note not found

put.summary: Update a learning card (title, description, status)

404.description: Card, milestone or note not found

delete.summary: Remove a learning card with its milestones and notes

delete.summary: Delete a habit and its completions

get.description: Archived tasks are excluded unless archived=true, which returns only archived tasks.
ACTIVE: not started or in progress, by priority. COMPLETED: history, latest first.

post.summary: Create a plan from existing tasks, habits and learning resources

TaskRequest.description: Status defaults to TODO, priority to MEDIUM

overdue.description: Due before today, not done, not archived

timezone.description: IANA timezone that decides what 'today' is

description.description: Description or source: link, book, course name

PlanItemRef.description: An existing task, habit or learning card

restSeconds.description: Seconds until end while IN_PROGRESS, otherwise null

serverTime.description: Server time used for the computation; clients count down from it

sourceAvailable.description: false when the source was deleted (I-5)

date.description: Defaults to today; future dates are rejected

MilestoneUpdate.description: Only the fields present are changed

PlanSources.description: Items that can be added to a plan (I-18)

milestonesCompletedLast7Days.description: Milestones completed in the last 7 days (I-15)
